svg.title: Pairing WhatsApp or Telegram
svg.desc: 1. The owner opens the employee's channel panel and chooses a channel. 2. Telegram: the bot token goes to the bridge, which writes the channel config for that employee and restarts the channel runtime. 3. WhatsApp: the bridge shows a QR code to scan and waits for the device link. 4. The UI polls the channel status until it is connected; access defaults to specific people only. 5. Outgoing WhatsApp messages pass one send gateway that paces replies and limits new numbers per day.
